This read creates no session, offers, or work; clients may poll and show preparation in progress.

post.description: Explicitly closes a sitting, skips an unanswered offer and queues an existing durable Lore refresh for its answers in the same transaction. Repeated finish is idempotent. It never runs a detached model call. Current claimant or administrator only. Private/no-store. Requires staging-verified migrations 0041 and 0042 before deployment. Draft; not released. When the approved claimant explicitly finishes a sitting containing a saved answer, the same transaction creates at most one private next sitting and queues its existing durable preparation job. The finished session ID is the deduplication key. Repeated Finish, skipped-only sittings, and untouched automatically prepared sittings never recursively queue another. An administrator finishing another artist’s sitting does not opt that artist in. The response still describes the finished sitting; GET then restores the next private sitting. No question is offered until explicit Start. Permanent instructions and newest answers apply to the next sitting; the finished sitting’s temporary instructions expire.

get.description: Read-only status for the session’s next question. Does not generate, enqueue or write. Stale means the session, claim, next ordinal or mandatory memory no longer matches the prepared candidate. A consumed preparation returns idle without jobId. A ready candidate is not a saved offer. Actual current approved claimant only; administrator status alone is insufficient. Bearer authentication is verified on every request; bearer tokens are never stored in the job. Private/no-store. Approved claims may automatically queue private question preparation after source research. The artist still explicitly chooses Start before any question is offered. Existing jobs wait for readable approved originals or artist-owned social text; pending Lore alone is not usable evidence. Existing readable artist context can proceed without waiting for unrelated Latest or ongoing research jobs. Waiting runs no model or scrape. Automatic waiting stops after 24 hours, and the same job becomes eligible again when usable evidence appears. Exact claimant ownership is rechecked before preparing. Reading pages or GET status never queues this work.

At most three sequential questions per sitting. For a session that has explicitly opted into durable preparation, all bank questions are offered at Start; subsequent answer saves preserve exact text and do not generate or run an eligibility model. New answers inform future sittings, not adaptive changes to the fixed current bank. Legacy partially offered checked banks can be upgraded through explicit Resume/consume when current memory and evidence still match. Existing offered questions and their timestamps are preserved; GET only exposes the needsPreparedBankResume hint. Changed memory prevents expansion. Legacy foreground sessions are unchanged. post.description: Performs one interview action. `start` opens a sitting and queues preparation; `prepare` queues it for an open sitting; `continue` consumes a ready question (or returns the one already offered); `answer` saves exact words and returns the state with `savedQuestion`; `finish` closes the sitting; `boundary` and `retract` save or retract a topic instruction and return `{ status: "ok" }`; `memory` returns the sitting's assembled mandatory memory; `boundaries` lists active instructions; `source` reads an original source window pinned to its revision. The sitting for `memory` and `boundaries` is the active one, else the next.

answer.description: The artist's exact words; null skips the question.

start.description: The window starts 1000 characters before this and reads 8000.

value.answer: We recorded it live in one take.

200.description: By action: the interview state (`start`, `prepare`, `continue`, `answer`, `finish`), `{ status: "ok" }` (`boundary`, `retract`), assembled memory (`memory`), a boundary page (`boundaries`) or a source window (`source`). `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

version.description: Required when includeVersion=true; omitted for legacy current-only reads.

SourceRead.description: Requested window from the pinned revision. nextStart continues the same revision; null means exhausted. Legacy empty/unreadable extraction is a successful empty window with unknown/failed extraction state where known, not proof of complete extraction.

Passage.description: Exact original-text window. Offsets are half-open UTF-16 code units into the requested evidence revision; surrogate pairs are not split. Page/audio locations are null without a verified extraction map. end-start equals text.length in JavaScript.

revision.description: Includes empty stored evidence, so unreadable/unknown sources remain identifiable without claiming readable content.

publishedAt.description: Preserve available precision; do not invent a time for a date-only publication.

description.description: Publisher metadata; not original body text and never sufficient support for a premise.

eventDate.description: Unknown in the current schema; never inferred from upload/publication time.

originalSourceUrl.description: No verified original/repost relationship is available in legacy storage.
